environment.description: Same application deployed on an ECS Fargate task in a private subnet (10.0.128.0/20) within a VPC that has no NAT gateway, no NAT instance, no VPC endpoints for S3/DynamoDB, and no internet gateway route in the subnet's route table. The subnet route table (rtb-0a4f8e2c) contains only the local route (10.0.0.0/16 -> local). DNS resolution is enabled within the VPC but external DNS queries timeout since there is no outbound path. The ECS task uses awsvpc networking mode with a security group (sg-0b7d3f1a) that has no outbound rules permitting traffic to 0.0.0.0/0 — only inbound on port 3000 from the internal ALB (sg-0c9e2d4b). The task execution role has ecr:GetAuthorizationToken scoped to the VPC endpoint for ECR (vpce-0d1f3a5c). Container images are pulled via the ECR VPC endpoint during deployment only.

config.security_group: sg-0b7d3f1a: inbound TCP/3000 from sg-0c9e2d4b only, no outbound rules
